name: MBNA Rewards World Elite Mastercard

apr.notes: Rates shown on the MBNA page for the Ontario region; MBNA states that rates and fees may vary across regions.

credit_required.notes: Personal annual income greater than $80,000 or household annual income of $150,000 or more.

base_rate.description: 1 point for every $1 on all other eligible purchases.

categories.label: Restaurant, grocery, digital media, membership and household utility purchases

rewards.redemption_notes: The redemption value for travel is 100 points per $1, while cash and charity donations are 120 points per $1.

signup_bonus.description: 20,000 bonus points after $2,000 or more in eligible purchases within the first 90 days, and 10,000 bonus points once enrolled for paperless e-statements within the first 90 days.

notes: Additional cardholder fee is $50. Birthday Bonus Points each year equal to 10% of points earned in the prior 12 months, up to 15,000 points. Network tier is World Elite Mastercard per the card name.
